content.text: {"name":"Hours-to-pay spread with 12-month trend change","hypothesis":"Groups whose average hours (V01) have risen relative to hourly pay (V05) over the past year, in cross-sectional terms, are gaining labor input versus cost and earn higher returns next month than groups where hours fell relative to pay.","falsified_if":"Mean cross-sectional rank IC is zero or negative in development statistics, or HAC t-stat is below 1.","expression":"spread(yoy(V01),yoy(V05))"}
